title: Annihilating the Holy Alliance
summary: Ye Fan and Jiang Huairen storm the Jiang clan's Liuxiang Island. Tingting testifies that Jiang Yichen stole the Mother of All Things Cauldron under the pretext of training at Meteorite Island, and Jiang Huairen wields Jiang Yi's Divine Wood Token to discipline his 'nephew'. Jiang Huai'an (Dragon Transformation) tries to cover for Yichen, but the cauldron is found at the 13th Grand Elder's island; Ye Fan threatens to smash it, forces the elder to give it up, and Jiang Yi himself arrives to fight the elder until the Great Ancestor intervenes and confines the schemers. Tingting reports that the Divine King Jiang Taixu cured her Chaotic Yin Body but is worsening and has vanished, facing either death within three years or rebirth within two. Jiang Yichen and Jiang Huai'an leak the cauldron's return, and that night the Wanchu and Zifu Holy Sons, backed by assassins, chase Ye Fan into Hei Huang's Great Emperor slaughter formation at Yanyun City. Ye Fan kills both Holy Sons, pretending they're assassin impostors, and keeps his promise to spare the two Jiang.
